title: Site Safety Inspection Checklist
name: Site Safety Inspection Checklist
description: Site safety inspection record for identifying unsafe conditions, checking controls, assigning actions and escalating significant findings. It does not replace task RAMS or permits to work.

sections.title: GENERAL SITE CONDITIONS
items: Site access, egress and emergency routes are clear and safe
Housekeeping and material storage are adequately controlled
Welfare facilities are available, clean and suitable
Fire precautions, escape arrangements and emergency information are in place
First-aid provision and emergency contacts are available
Temporary lighting, edge protection and general access routes are suitable

sections.title: WORK ACTIVITIES AND HIGH-RISK CONTROLS
items: Current high-risk work has the correct permit / authorisation where required
RAMS and task briefings are available and understood for work observed
Work at height controls and access equipment are suitable
Excavations, openings and temporary works are adequately controlled
Lifting operations and exclusion arrangements are suitably controlled
Plant, vehicles and pedestrians are adequately segregated
Electrical equipment, temporary supplies and isolations are suitably controlled
PPE requirements are suitable and being followed
Environmental controls for dust, noise, waste and spills are being maintained

sections.title: FINDINGS, ACTIONS AND ESCALATION
items: Immediate danger has been stopped or made safe before the inspection continues
Each significant finding has been clearly described and evidenced
Corrective actions have a named owner
Action target dates reflect the seriousness of the finding
Significant issues have been escalated to the appropriate site management
Follow-up or re-inspection requirements are recorded
